verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer-token OAuth authentication for accessing/creating/manipulating content, and this is independently verified by a runtime probe showing a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec at api.capacities.io and a correctly bearer-gated /spaces endpoint. It also exposes an official hosted MCP server (with OAuth-scoped read/write) confirmed live via probe, giving AI-native users multiple documented, working integration paths. Missing for 10: deeper endpoint-level documentation excerpts and independent third-party developer testimonials beyond the runtime probes.
